distinct_stochastic_result: Justified fixed-horizon boundary limits at fixed rho. For rho=0,n=0, E delta N -> (lambda-1)t; for rho=1/2,n=0, lambda=10, E delta N >=7t. These block a raw-population fixed-time Foster shortcut while leaving the global V proof intact.
